catppuccin.title: Catppuccin
catppuccin.description: Theme based on the popular Catppuccin palette (Mocha variant): soothing pastel accents over deep dark backgrounds.

matte-black.title: Matte Black
matte-black.description: Theme with a matte black background and a strong orange accent. Sleek, high-contrast, and low-distraction.

gruvbox.title: Gruvbox
gruvbox.description: Theme based on the retro groove color scheme (gruvbox), with warm earthy browns and muted greens.

nord.title: Nord
nord.description: Theme with cold, muted blue-gray tones from the Nord palette, with crisp arctic-inspired contrast.

osaka-jade.title: Osaka Jade
osaka-jade.description: Theme by Justin Lowry. A dark jade-green palette inspired by Osaka aesthetics, pairing deep green backgrounds with warm highlights.

tokyo-night.title: Tokyo Night
tokyo-night.description: Theme based on the popular Tokyo Night color scheme by Enkia. Deep blue backgrounds with cyan, blue, and purple neon accents evoking Tokyo after dark.

solitude.title: Solitude
solitude.description: Minimal monochrome theme by HANCORE. Near-black backgrounds with quiet gray tones for a calm, distraction-free workspace.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Panoramas and iconic scenery inspired by individual countries.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Wallpapers dedicated to specific cities and their landmarks.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: Wallpapers dedicated to great historical figures.

shelters.title: Shelters
shelters.description: Cozy improvised refuges tucked into the city: rooftop cabins, hidden workshops and warmly lit nooks after dark.
